says: Who takes part: a person or an agent, what they are called, and the other names they go by - so that what waits on someone can be drawn.

Where everything lives: every surface something of this work is kept on - in a place or outside any - what shape it holds there, how it is read now, and what is lacking for it to be read. So that what the ecosystem does not yet consume is in view, beside what it does.
